Contact page Google Maps integration verified with correct URLs. Admin dashboard components exist but inaccessible due to frontend login issue (separate from feature implementation).

action_item_for_main_agent: Fix frontend login form submission: The login form on /login page does not submit credentials to the backend API. After clicking submit, the page stays on /login and no POST request is sent to /api/auth/login. This prevents admin access to the WhatsApp leads dashboard. Backend authentication is working correctly (verified via API tests). Check: 1) Form onSubmit handler, 2) API call in login component, 3) Token storage in localStorage/context after successful login.
